images.scene: a phone ringing on a desk covered in stat sheets and coffee cups, a half-empty arena visible through the office window in the background, overhead fluorescent lights casting harsh shadows
images.alt: A GM's office after hours, phone ringing, trade deadline season

images.scene: a head coach standing at the blue line with arms crossed, back to the camera, facing an empty bench with two water bottles and a clipboard left on it, arena lights humming above in the after-hours silence
images.alt: A lone coach confronts an empty bench after a late loss

images.scene: a young center in a plain white sweater taking a faceoff in the offensive zone, head up, stick on the ice, arena lights reflecting off the boards behind him, no identifiable markings
images.alt: A center winning a draw in the attacking zone

images.scene: a goaltender in a plain dark sweater standing alone in the crease, glove raised, arena lights catching the ice in front of him, an empty net visible behind
images.alt: Goaltender alone in the crease under arena lights

images.scene: a draft lottery ping-pong ball rolling across a felt table under harsh overhead lights, a hand in a business suit reaching toward it, the background dark and out of focus
images.alt: A draft lottery ball rolls toward a waiting hand

images.scene: four young players in plain dark sweaters at a morning skate, two wingers and a defenceman clustered near the faceoff circle while a veteran stands alone at the far blue line watching them under fluorescent arena lights
images.alt: Young players cluster at center ice while a lone veteran watches from the blue line

images.scene: Manny Fernandez, Minnesota Wild number 29 in the green and gold 2004-05 home sweater, skating alone back to the bench during a timeout at the Xcel Energy Center, head down, stick dragging on the ice, telephoto from behind the net, cold arena light, empty seats visible in the upper bowl
images.alt: Fernandez returns to the bench during a Minnesota Wild game

images.scene: Marian Gaborik, Toronto Maple Leafs number 10 in the white 2004-05 home sweater, cutting left-to-right across the slot with the puck on his backhand, a Columbus Blue Jackets defender trailing at full stretch, telephoto from the blue line behind the goal, arena light, crowd blurred behind the glass
images.alt: Gaborik driving the net for Toronto

images.scene: Toronto Maple Leafs bench during a stoppage in play, 2004-05 season, players in blue and white jerseys leaning on the boards watching the faceoff in the far zone, head coach standing with arms crossed at the end of the bench, overhead arena light on the ice surface, the empty red seats of the Air Canada Centre in the background
images.alt: Toronto's bench during a game in their 2004-05 sweater

images.scene: Martin Brodeur, New Jersey Devils number 30 in the red 2004-05 home sweater, sitting on the bench with his glove off and stick across his lap, looking toward the ice at the Continental Airlines Arena, arena light from above, telephoto from the side boards
images.alt: Brodeur on the bench watching from behind the glass

images.scene: Colorado Avalanche player in the burgundy 2004-05 home sweater, clearing the puck off his own blue line against an Edmonton Oilers forward in the white road sweater at SkyDome at Rexall Place, Edmonton, telephoto from behind the net, arena light
images.alt: Colorado defender clears the zone against Edmonton in the November 30 game

images.scene: David Aebischer, Toronto Maple Leafs number 34 in the blue 2004-05 home sweater, pushing off a post with his left pad to cover the five-hole against a Tampa Bay Lightning forward at the Air Canada Centre, shot from the near-side glass, arena light catching ice spray
images.alt: Aebischer covering the five-hole in the 6-0 shutout of Tampa Bay on December 3

images.scene: Brad Richards, Toronto Maple Leafs number 11 in the white 2004-05 road sweater, winning a faceoff in the offensive zone against a Philadelphia Flyers centre, low angle from behind the net, arena light reflecting off the ice
images.alt: Richards winning a draw in the 4-2 road win over Philadelphia on November 29

images.scene: Ed Jovanovski, Vancouver Canucks number 3 in the blue and green 2004-05 home sweater, limping off the ice at General Motors Place holding his left knee, teammates in white looking back from the blue line, arena overhead lighting casting harsh shadows on the boards, telephoto from the penalty box side
images.alt: Jovanovski leaving the ice after injury

images.scene: Cliff Ronning, Philadelphia Flyers number 23 in the orange 2004-05 home sweater, skating slowly up the ice during a change, stick low, head down, the bench behind him in shadow, arena light flat and harsh, wide shot from the glass at center ice
images.alt: Cliff Ronning skates off the ice after another 9-minute shift

images.scene: David Aebischer, Toronto Maple Leafs number 31 in the blue 2004-05 home sweater, crouched in his crease after stopping a shot, glove hand raised, during the game against the New York Islanders at Nassau Coliseum, arena light, wide angle from behind the net
images.alt: Aebischer holds the crease during the 4-0 shutout of New York

images.scene: Empty Philadelphia Flyers home end after a loss, a single fan in a $78 seat near the blue line clapping sarcastically, the ice still resurfaced and gleaming under full arena light, wide angle from the upper deck looking down, the scoreboard showing a L4 streak
images.alt: One fan applauds in an otherwise empty arena

images.scene: Marian Gaborik, Toronto Maple Leafs number 10 in the white 2004-05 away sweater, wheeling behind the defense with the puck on his backhand during a game at the Air Canada Centre, shot from the low boards, arena light catching the number on his jersey
images.alt: Gaborik has 20 goals and a 95 overall on a contract that expires in July

images.scene: Landon Wilson, Phoenix Coyotes number 14 in the dark 2004-05 home sweater, sitting at the end of the bench during a stoppage, helmet off, towel over his head, looking toward the ice where a teammate drops the puck for a faceoff. Empty fourth row visible behind the glass at Jobing.com Arena, harsh overhead lighting.
images.alt: Wilson on the bench while Phoenix's first line wins a faceoff

images.scene: Garth Snow, New York Islanders goaltender in the road 2004-05 sweater, skating his crease during a morning warmup at the Mellon Arena, leg pads wide, glove hand raised, flat overhead arena lighting, telephoto from behind the net
images.alt: Garth Snow warms up in the Islanders road sweater before tonight's game in Pittsburgh

images.scene: Jamie Langenbrunner, New Jersey Devils, in the red 2004-05 home sweater, receiving a knee examination from a team trainer at the Devils' bench during a pre-game skate, overhead arena light casting long shadows across the ice, shot from the glass with shallow depth of field
images.alt: A Devils trainer examines a player's knee at the bench

images.scene: A Tampa Bay Lightning forward in the home 2004-05 sweater, mid-celebration after scoring, teammates converging near the goal line at the St. Pete Times Forum, Edmonton Oilers defender skating away in the background, telephoto from the far side, bright arena lighting
images.alt: Lightning players celebrate one of their 7 goals against Edmonton

images.scene: Mike Cammalleri, Los Angeles number 13 in the black 2004-05 home sweater, collecting a puck on the forehand at the left circle and driving toward the net, a Chicago defender trailing half a step, telephoto from the bluish side of the arena, cold light from above
images.alt: Cammalleri drives the net at home

images.scene: Peter Forsberg, Colorado Avalanche number 23 in the home 2004-05 sweater, skating the puck up the left wing at the Pepsi Center, head up surveying the ice, telephoto from the far bench, cold arena light casting a hard shadow under the boards
images.alt: Peter Forsberg carries the puck in Colorado's home sweater at the Pepsi Center
